name: pipeline-builder
description: CopilotHarness pipeline-builder pipeline: scaffolds NEW pipelines from a brief. plan → design → code → review with evaluator firewall and 3-attempt correction loop.

skillLocality.rationale: Pipeline-authoring knowledge is embedded in each agent's .md file. The harness's _STAGE_SKILL_MAP auto-injects feature-dev's defaults (api-design / python / code-review) keyed by (stage, agent_name) and is not pipeline-aware; retargeting it would also retarget feature-dev. Promote to a global skill at .github/skills/pipeline-authoring/ when (a) a second pipeline-authoring use-case appears, or (b) the auto-injection map gains pipeline_name support.
